title: Prohibition Enforcement of Hadd Amendment Act 1994

sections.shortTitle: Prohibition Enforcement of Hadd Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 1994
ACT VI OF 1994
PROHIBITION (ENFORCEMENT OF HADD) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Order,
1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 14th June, 1994]
The following Act of
Majlis-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent e President on the 8th June,
1994, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

The following Act of

2. Amendment of Article 4, P.O. 4 of 1979.--In the Prohibition
(Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979 (P.0.4 of 1979), in Article 4, in the second
proviso, the word "raw", occurring twice, shall be omitted.
